change_percent.description: The change as a percentage of the previous total's size, to one decimal, half away from zero (RND-PERCENT), with the change's sign; absent when the previous total is zero. For showing only: the thresholds compare the exact amounts.

current.description: Its total for the period in the base currency: debit positive, credit negative, so income is negative, as in the trial balance.

explained.description: The latest explanation is of the totals as they are now; once either total changes it is stale, and the close asks for a new one.

explanation.description: The latest explanation, current or stale; absent while there is none.

needs_explanation.description: The change is more than both thresholds, so the close needs an explanation of it.

previous.description: Its total for the previous period.

type.description: revenue (income) or expense: balance-sheet accounts rely on the support the close requires.
